title: Hermeus news strip
description: A thin white strip above the page: an amber dot and a small NEWS tag at the left, one uppercase headline with an arrow (centred on desktop, truncated on phones) and a close cross at the right. The headline turns amber on hover; the cross hides the strip.
notes: needs JavaScript (hydrate: idle) for the close button; static HTML shows the strip
name: hermeus-announcement

props.name: tag
props.description: the small tag after the amber dot, e.g. "News"

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: accessible name of the close button
